title: Generative AI Integration for PLM
summary: A proof of concept for conversational access to engineering and product information in PLM systems.
overview: Designed and developed a Generative AI solution integrated with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems, enabling users to query PLM information using conversational language instead of navigating complex data structures and reports.
challenge: Make product structures, documents, metadata and project information easier to discover through natural-language interaction while grounding responses in enterprise data and respecting user permissions.
architecture: Connect Large Language Models (LLMs) with PLM repositories and PostgreSQL databases.
Use Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to ground responses in enterprise information.
Convert natural-language queries into SQL and PLM-specific searches.
Index documents and support semantic retrieval with embedding models and vector databases.
Integrate local LLMs through Ollama for secure, on-premises deployment scenarios.
Enforce access controls so responses respect existing user permissions.
contributions: Developed an AI-powered assistant for PLM data retrieval and knowledge discovery.
Integrated LLMs with PLM repositories and PostgreSQL databases.
Implemented RAG-based responses, natural-language-to-SQL conversion and PLM-specific search.
Built document indexing and semantic search capabilities using embeddings and vector databases.
Integrated Ollama local LLMs to support secure on-premises deployments.
Implemented access controls to align AI responses with existing user permissions.
value: Enables faster conversational discovery of product structures, documents, metadata and project information, supporting engineering productivity.
confidentiality: Proof-of-concept description. Do not include confidential PLM records, customer data, internal prompts or deployment details in public demonstrations.
